summary: Appropriates $21,775,500 from fund balances: $21,625,500 from the General Services District General Fund and $150,000 from the Urban Services District Debt Fund. The largest pieces are $13.1 million for correctional healthcare and $6,282,300 for Sheriff Annex Facility salaries and benefits, with the rest going to tornado siren repairs, other Administrative Department costs, other Sheriff Annex Facility costs, and debt service.
